description: criticalsec.com operator deployment — Google Workspace login pinned to a single operator. The reference deploy profile (and the robco-google template): an auth-only standup with no outbound population. Google OIDC is the login path; george@criticalsec.com becomes tap_admin on first verified login.

auth.description: Single-operator auth for the criticalsec.com instance: one google_oidc provider restricted to the criticalsec.com Workspace domain and pinned to george@criticalsec.com, who is the initial admin. Local password login stays enabled as the recovery floor until the Google path is confirmed in production.

providers.description: Google Workspace OIDC for criticalsec.com. allowed_domains enforces the returned hd claim; allowed_emails pins login to the single operator even though the whole domain is otherwise eligible.
